row.title: What Works moved to its own repository
row.body: Rowan created ultrastable/what-works (2026-11-25) and asked for it to be public. The tenant folder was split with its history, the core files it reads vendored (tenantrepos --prepare) and a CI workflow added; topology now builds ultrastable-what-works from that repository's main (worker/index.js), the registry state is moved and the worker code left the core. Seedlife and deploy read the repository over raw.githubusercontent.com, so it must be public.
